translations.web: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
translations.bsb: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
translations.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
translations.asv: For this cause ye pay tribute also; for they are ministers of God's service, attending continually upon this very thing.
